Site Credits

Built for Friends-Grid.com

OpenSim Grid Hosting

Dedicated grid and region hosting designed around OpenSimulator communities, with room to expand as a world grows.

Custom Grid Tools

Customer and admin portals can provide region controls, maps, account tools, land features and day-to-day grid management.

Backups & Rollback

Hosting solutions include backup, storage and rollback options intended to make recovery and grid maintenance easier.

Migration & Support

Existing OpenSim projects can get help with migrations, upgrades, custom configurations and ongoing hosting support.

Want your own grid and website like this?

Hosting4Opensim builds and hosts OpenSimulator solutions for grid owners, region owners and virtual-world communities. Explore the service information, or browse H4HUB Grid Packages when you are ready to start your own grid.
